seoTitle: Find Competitors' Backlinks in Semrush Step by Step
metaDescription: Learn how to analyze a competitor's backlink profile in Semrush, check referring domains and authority score, and find backlink gap opportunities.
intro: Studying where your competitors get their backlinks is one of the fastest ways to find new link building opportunities. This guide covers how to use Semrush's Backlink Analytics tool to check referring domains, anchor text, and authority score for any competitor domain, and how to spot gaps you can fill. It's aimed at anyone trying to grow their own authority by learning from what's already working for others.

steps.heading: Open the Backlink Analytics tool
steps.body: Log into Semrush and go to Backlink Analytics to start researching a competitor's backlink profile.

steps.heading: Enter the competitor's domain
steps.body: Type in the competitor domain you want to analyze so Semrush can pull their referring domains and link data.

steps.heading: Analyze referring domains and authority score
steps.body: Review the list of domains linking to your competitor and check their authority score to prioritize the highest-value link sources.

steps.heading: Check anchor text and link types
steps.body: Look at the anchor text being used and distinguish between dofollow and nofollow links to understand the quality of each backlink.

steps.heading: Find backlink gap opportunities
steps.body: Use the backlink gap feature to spot domains linking to competitors but not to you, giving you a targeted outreach list.

faq.question: Can I see every backlink a competitor has?
faq.answer: Semrush shows a large database of backlinks it has indexed, though it may not capture every single link that exists across the entire web.

faq.question: What's the difference between dofollow and nofollow links?
faq.answer: Dofollow links pass link equity that can help SEO, while nofollow links generally don't, though both can still bring referral traffic.

faq.question: What is the backlink gap tool used for?
faq.answer: The backlink gap tool compares multiple domains to reveal sites linking to competitors but not to you, highlighting outreach opportunities.

faq.question: How does authority score help prioritize link building?
faq.answer: Authority score gives a quick way to judge how valuable a referring domain likely is, helping you focus outreach on higher-impact sites first.
